title: Anime Open World Ananta Launches 8 Weeks After GTA6 on PS5
description: Anime-inspired open world game Ananta is reportedly launching 8 Weeks after GTA6 on January 15 as a PS5 console exclusive.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A Clash of Titans: Ananta Set for PS5 Following GTA6

The gaming landscape is shaping up for an intense period of competition. According to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square, the anime-inspired open world title Ananta—not to be confused with the already-available NTE—is slated to launch approximately eight weeks after GTA6.

## PS5 Exclusive and January 15 Release Date Confirmed

Promotional materials for this long-anticipated PS5 console exclusive appear to have solidified a January 15 release date. The title is also poised to make an official appearance at Gamescom Opening Night Live later today, where further details are expected to be unveiled.

Positioning a major release just eight weeks after a colossal industry event like GTA6 is a bold move. While GTA6 will undoubtedly dominate the gaming sphere upon its launch, a distinct anime-inspired open world experience targeting the PS5 console market could carve out a dedicated player base looking for something entirely different once the initial dust settles.

## Context and Market Outlook

As developers look at the towering shadow of GTA6, finding the right release window has become a delicate science. Ananta’s strategy to position itself shortly after the heavyweight launch highlights how publishers are navigating the crowded gaming calendar. All eyes will be on its Gamescom presence to see how it intends to stand out.

## Editor's Take

Launching an open-world title just eight weeks after GTA6 is a high-stakes gamble. While Ananta targets a completely different demographic with its anime aesthetic and PS5 exclusivity, capturing player attention during a post-GTA6 window will be a formidable challenge. Its upcoming showcase at Gamescom will be crucial in proving its market readiness.
